issue.title: Simplify compact data table padding and row actions
issue.description:
Refine the compact data-table gallery composition so the table sits more directly inside the card and follows the cleaner shadcn-style row structure.

Owner direction:

* Remove the card's vertical padding currently applied as py-6.
* Remove the CardContent horizontal padding currently applied as px-6.
* Let the table sit flush against the card's inner edges while preserving the card border/radius and readable table cell padding.
* Remove the colored status dots from every Status cell.
* Add a checkbox/select column on the far left.
* Add a row-actions ellipsis / three-dots column on the far right.
* The action column header must remain blank; do NOT show a three-dots icon in the header.

Target table structure:

* checkbox column
* Status
* Email
* Amount
* blank header for row actions

Example conceptually:

| ☐ | Status | Email | Amount |  |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| ☐ | Success | [ken99@example.com](<mailto:ken99@example.com>) | $316.00 | ⋯ |
| ☐ | Success | [abe45@example.com](<mailto:abe45@example.com>) | $242.00 | ⋯ |
| ☐ | Processing | [monserrat44@example.com](<mailto:monserrat44@example.com>) | $837.00 | ⋯ |
| ☐ | Success | [silas22@example.com](<mailto:silas22@example.com>) | $874.00 | ⋯ |
| ☐ | Failed | [carmella@example.com](<mailto:carmella@example.com>) | $721.00 | ⋯ |

Checkbox behavior:

* Include a header/select-all checkbox if it fits the existing shadcn Table pattern cleanly.
* Row checkboxes may be interactive.
* Selection must not change card height or add footer/summary UI.

Row actions:

* Each data row may show an icon-only ellipsis/three-dots action button on the far right.
* Keep the header cell for this column empty.
* Do not add a visible column label or action icon in the header.
* A lightweight menu is optional only if it already fits the accepted component set cleanly; the visual affordance is the main requirement.
* Do not add workflow-heavy actions that reshape the composition.

Preserve:

* Status, Email, and Amount columns.
* Current example rows/data unless a small content cleanup is needed.
* Current table borders/dividers using semantic tokens.
* Outer card border and radius.
* Responsive containment.
* Light/dark behavior.
* Existing Table public resource and registry architecture.

Do not:

* reintroduce filter/search controls;
* add Columns selector;
* add selected-row summary;
* add Previous/Next pagination;
* add status dots;
* remove normal table-cell padding;
* create a new generic data-grid abstraction;
* change unrelated gallery compositions.

Accessibility:

* Header/select-all checkbox must have an accessible name.
* Row checkboxes must have meaningful accessible labels.
* Row action buttons must have accessible names.
* Preserve table semantics, keyboard focus, and logical reading order.

Acceptance:

* The outer table card no longer uses the previous py-6 vertical card padding.
* CardContent no longer uses the previous px-6 horizontal padding.
* The table visually sits flush within the card while table cells retain appropriate internal spacing.
* Status dots are removed.
* A checkbox column appears on the far left.
* A row-actions ellipsis column appears on the far right.
* The far-right header cell is blank.
* No ellipsis icon appears in the action-column header.
* Status / Email / Amount content remains intact.
* No filter, Columns control, selection summary, or pagination is introduced.
* Light/dark/theme-token responsiveness remains intact.
* No overflow, keyboard, focus, accessibility, or responsive regression.
